mapper.select: select t.id, t.assignee_sys_user_id as assigneeSysUserId, t.subject_type as subjectType, t.subject_id as subjectId, t.status, t.priority, t.due_at as dueAt, t.completed_at as completedAt, t.created_at as createdAt, t.updated_at as updatedAt, case when t.status != 'done' and t.due_at < now() then 1 else 0 end as overdue, su.user_name as assigneeUserName, su.nick_name as assigneeNickName, nz.value as noteZh, nf.value as noteFr, ne.value as noteEn from cm_staff_tasks t left join sys_user su on su.user_id = t.assignee_sys_user_id left join cm_staff_task_localized_fields nz on nz.staff_task_id = t.id and nz.field_name = 'note' and nz.locale = 'zh' left join cm_staff_task_localized_fields nf on nf.staff_task_id = t.id and nf.field_name = 'note' and nf.locale = 'fr' left join cm_staff_task_localized_fields ne on ne.staff_task_id = t.id and ne.field_name = 'note' and ne.locale = 'en' where t.id = #{id} limit 1

select t.id as taskId, t.assignee_sys_user_id as assigneeSysUserId, t.subject_type as subjectType, t.subject_id as subjectId, t.due_at as dueAt, coalesce(nz.value, t.id) as note from cm_staff_tasks t left join cm_staff_task_localized_fields nz on nz.staff_task_id = t.id and nz.field_name = 'note' and nz.locale = 'zh' join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.assignee_sys_user_id and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' where t.status != 'done' and t.due_at is not null and t.due_at < now() order by t.due_at, t.id limit #{batchSize}
select user_id as userId, user_name as userName, nick_name as nickName from sys_user where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' order by user_name
mapper.update: update cm_staff_tasks set assignee_sys_user_id = #{assigneeSysUserId}, status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, due_at = #{dueAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_staff_task_localized_fields ( id, staff_task_id, field_name, locale, value, source, provider, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{staffTaskId}, 'note', #{locale}, #{value}, 'manual', 'human', 'ready', current_timestamp, current_timestamp ) on duplicate key update value = values(value), source = 'manual', provider = 'human', status = 'ready', updated_at = current_timestamp
